description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for marine microbial genomic sequencing samples collected across global oceanic regions, capturing geospatial, environmental, habitat, and sampling context relevant to diversity analyses.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record (e.g., station code or accession-linked sample name).

collection_date.descr: Date the sample was collected in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

site_name.descr: Human-readable name of the sampling site or station.

ocean_region.descr: Large-scale oceanic region or basin where the sample was collected (e.g., North Atlantic, South Pacific, Indian Ocean).

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative for south.

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative for west.

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth below sea surface in meters (m).

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the sampling depth in degrees Celsius (°C).

salinity_psu.descr: In situ salinity at the sampling location in practical salinity units (PSU).

biome_type.descr: Broad biome or habitat classification of the sampling site (e.g., coral reef, open ocean, coastal, estuary, deep sea).

environmental_feature.descr: Specific environmental feature or context associated with the site (e.g., proximity to hydrothermal vents, upwelling zone, sea-ice edge, oxygen minimum zone).

distance_to_feature_km.descr: Distance from the sample location to the named environmental feature in kilometers (km), if applicable.

seafloor_type.descr: Seafloor or substrate context when relevant (e.g., pelagic water column, sediment, reef-associated, benthic).

sample_material.descr: Material actually collected for sequencing (e.g., seawater, filtered biomass, sediment, biofilm).

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used to collect microbial biomass, in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

sampling_platform.descr: Platform used for sample collection (e.g., research vessel, autonomous sampler, ROV, CTD rosette).

sequencing_assay.descr: Sequencing approach used to generate the genomic data (e.g., metagenomics, 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing, shotgun sequencing).

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol or kit used for the sample.

target_gene.descr: Target gene or genomic region, if amplicon-based sequencing was performed (e.g., 16S rRNA, 18S rRNA, ITS).

reads_count.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed the project's quality-control criteria for inclusion in downstream analysis.

sampling_event_notes.descr: Free-text notes about unusual sampling conditions, weather, contamination concerns, or other relevant observations.
